MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The smart plug feels like a useful next purchase because it would let me control a lamp with the Echo devices I already use, adding a function to my current setup.",
    "The HDMI cable fits my history of connecting home entertainment equipment, although I would only choose it when I actually need a ten-foot cable."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Fire TV sticks repeat a need already covered by my recent 4K Max bundle, and the older versions give me no clear reason to switch.",
    "The tablets do not match a current need, especially after my Echo Show purchase; sharing Alexa support is not enough to make me want another screen.",
    "Past storage purchases and owning a card reader do not mean I need another memory card now. Likewise, another speaker or wired earbuds would need a specific use that I do not currently have."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My use of Alexa devices seems to have been taken as interest in almost any Alexa product, even when it duplicates something I already own.",
    "My long history of buying electronics accessories seems to have been treated as an ongoing need for more storage, cables, and audio equipment."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent purchases matter: the 4K Max and Echo Show already cover the immediate uses behind several suggestions.",
    "Accessories appeal to me when they solve a concrete problem with equipment I own, as my replacement Harmony batteries and Echo Show stand suggest; compatibility alone does not create a need.",
    "I distinguish between something that could be useful later, like the HDMI cable, and something I would try now, like using a smart plug with my Echo devices."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The suggestions recognize my connected-home interests but too often repeat existing capabilities instead of identifying a useful next addition."
}
